item.title: Health officials issue new rabies alert in Marion County in light of infected raccoon
item.description: Marion County is under a new rabies alert after a confirmed case was identified in a raccoon in the southeast portion of the county, just a few months after several other local animals tested positive for the disease. item.description: The former Silver Springs Bottled Water Co. facility in Ocala will remain operational with reduced production and volume following the sale of the company last year and subsequent termination of dozens of employees. item.title: Ocala man operating steamroller dies after vehicle overturns on embankment
item.description: An Ocala man who was driving a steamroller up an embankment on Monday morning was killed after the vehicle overturned and struck him. Read more: Ocala man operating steamroller dies after vehicle overturns on embankment

item.title: I’m glad the proposed food truck in south Marion was denied.
item.description: "I was not in support of the food truck park location. Reason being: The site does not support the traffic in the area. The road would have to be widened to support the traffic. The vinyl fence they wanted to substitute for the mason wall was not to code. The farms in the local area did not want the noise that comes with that kind of traffic. We have always prided ourselves on having the quiet area and that food truck park would have destroyed that reputation." - A Marion County resident shares
